_comment: The add-on ships both VENDOR.md and VENDORS.md, each naming the same bundled file with a DIFFERENT source. Which one the review reads would be decided by archive order, so multiple-vendor-files errors and names both. Nothing else reads either file - readVendorFile returns null for an ambiguous manifest - so vendor-unparseable does not also fire, and the path both manifests name is not treated as vendored.
